name: a-tail-call-module-is-refused
note: One of the three proposals the leaf engine runs rather than refuses: wasm3 loads, compiles and executes `return_call`, returning 1 (eieio-7d8.26). So this one is refused in the loader, on every host, and the refusal names the proposal on every host too — which is why this scenario runs on wasm3 where the six engine-layer ones cannot assert a name.
